thesis: The episode explores the history of WCM, a firm that grew from $25 billion to over $66 billion in assets while defying active management outflows. It features an interview with Mike Trigg, a partner and portfolio manager at WCM, who discusses his unconventional background starting as a writer for the Motley Fool before joining the firm.
